project: Ethiopia ECMWF CHIRPS seasonal calibration - ONDJ (September initialization)
provenance_note: CDS SEAS5 system 51, total_precipitation, 1 September initialization, lead 24-3672 h (153 days), area N15 W33 S3 E48; 25 members 1993-2016, 51 from 2017. CHIRPS archive ends Dec 2025, so complete ONDJ observations exist for seasons 1993/94-2024/25.
